_about: Print minimums used by print_check.py and targets.py. Every value cites written-sources.md (W ids) or a video SPEC in research/design-audit/. 'fail' means ink will not hold or the gap will close; 'warn' is the production-safe level. Edit here, not in code. Tapstitch publishes no artwork spec (none found 7 Oct 2026); ask them for the jacket method's minimums and update this file.

screen.label: screen print (plastisol, direct)
screen.sources: line 1 pt ESTABLISHED (W40, W43, W45, W49, Transfer Express video); gap 1.5 pt (W45) to 2 pt (W44), CONFLICT up to 2.9 pt for heat-pressed screen transfers (W40, W41, Transfer Express video). line warn 0.50 mm is a margin over the 1 pt floor, not a sourced number.

screen_transfer.label: screen-printed heat transfer
screen_transfer.sources: 0.012 in line, 0.04 in show-through (W40, W41, Transfer Express video, same company so SINGLE SOURCE)

dtf.label: DTF (Tapstitch fleece: hoodie, crewneck)
dtf.sources: line 0.5 mm absolute ESTABLISHED (W42, W52, W55, W50; Transfer Express video 1.29 pt), 0.8 to 1 mm production-safe ESTABLISHED (W50, W51, W53); gaps CONFLICT: no minimum (W41, Transfer Express video) vs about 1 mm (W50, W53), so warn only

dtg.label: DTG on dark fabric with white underbase (Tapstitch tee)
dtg.sources: line 2 pt (W57) to 3 pt (W44), about 2.4 pt (W58), ESTABLISHED; no DTG gap source found, warn borrows the screen-print 2 pt gap as a proxy (ASSUMPTION)

text.sources: garment text minimum CONFLICT 4 to 18 pt (W50, W53, W54, W56, W57); stricter sources overlap 10 to 14 pt; fail below 7 pt per W50 technical minimum. cap_height_to_em 0.68 is a typical serif value used to estimate point size from measured cap height (approximation; real faces run 0.65 to 0.72).

rebuild.ring_weight_ratios_source: three weights at about 1:2:4, ISO pen series (W36, W37, W38): ESTABLISHED in technical drawing, an analogy for logos. Adjacent weights closer than about 1.4x do not read as distinct (derived from the ISO sqrt 2 step).
rebuild.inner_field_source: regulated engineer seals (W68, W69): reference range only, a seal with two text zones will sit below it

spread_preview_source: illustrative only: no source gives a spread figure in mm; 0.1 mm per edge closes a 0.2 mm gap, half the screen-print gap floor
